tolerance_basis: Illustration approximations at1.8m body scale, not clinical limits or exact collision guarantees.12mm near-contact band,4mm penetration,5mm tangential drift.

ventral_pelvis_L.rationale: Anterior pelvic skin remains planted through all phases; not a posterior-glute proxy.

anterior_thigh_L.rationale: Local anterior thigh skin supporting the prone leg, separate from pelvis and knee.

anterior_shin_L.rationale: Local anterior lower-leg support, separate from foot dorsum.

foot_dorsum_L.rationale: Actual dorsal foot contact in pointed prone feet; not a falsely flat sole.

palm_heel_L.rationale: Actual palm heel, independent of finger-tip and wrist bone targets.

thumb_pad_L.rationale: Distal articulated finger pad kept near floor; not the whole hand minimum.
